notes.title: Version v1.04
notes.notes:
Version v1.04!

A patch with fixes.

[u]Fixes:[/u][list]
[*]  - The shards ritual button is no longer active in towns, since a free ritual is given there
[*]  - Fixed damage in the description of the skill 'Blizzard': it dealt 2 times more than stated in the description. The skill was left as is, and the damage in the description was increased by 2 times
[*]  - Fixed damage in the description of the skill 'Overload': previously it gave +25% damage per level in the description, but +50% in reality. Now in both cases it gives +50%
[*]  - Fix for not counting the wax from falling wax particles in global stats and flame power calculations. The change affects the 'Ecology' skill, the bonus from bats from the 4th Dragon syllable and the bonus from 'eye' type creatures
[*]  - Fixed the behavior of Wind Seal II with Wind King Mask. Previously, it continued to block soul acceleration, despite the fact that upgrading the seal from level 1 to level 2 removes the debuffs. Now the Wind King Mask accelerates souls as intended
[*]  - Fixed a bug where during a transformation animation (Beetle, General, Wolf) you could start another transformation and ruin your shard walkthrough
[/list]

notes.title: Space probes, Location maps
notes.notes:
Version v.099

[b]This is a new content update that adds location maps and explorer probes, as well as fixes a few bugs.
[/b]

[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Location maps! These can be obtained by exploring probes that sometimes fly around shards in space. Maps can also be obtained at the end of galaxies instead of temporary knowledge bonuses. There are maps for every location in the game
[*] When you take a map for a location, the player gets a permanent bonus to damage in that location: +20% for the first map, and 10% for each of the following maps.
[*] If you have at least one map, you can open a new window. That window tells you info about each location that player has a map for. A card shows which enemies can be encountered at the location, as well as the location's look, flavor text, and current bonus
[*] In the Space, this window can be opened by clicking on a new button. Inside a shard it's a sub-menu within the 'Space' window
[/list]

[h3]Probes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The probes come in two types: normal and broken probes. Broken probes must first be repaired for a resource. For normal probes it's enough to just fly up to them
[*] Both types of probes examine a shard until player reaches that shard. The probe then becomes available for interaction, and gives a random location map
[*] Probes are randomly distributed throughout the galaxies, depending on size of each. In a small galaxy, there is a chance of not encountering a single probe at all. In a large galaxy, you may encounter up to three probes
[*] Probes should still appear in a galaxy if player was in the middle of exploring it before this update
[/list]

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a long-standing issue with giving out temporary knowledge rewards at the end of a galaxy, such as stat discounts. The rewards would be given out right before jumping into a black hole, then immediately reset. Now all temporary rewards at the bottom of the list are replaced by a random location map reward
[*] Fixed an issue with random masks for female incarnation in the Destiny shards. As a result, the random mask sets for each of the 4 characters have been reworked (counting male and female characters as one)
[*] Also added Apocalypse mask to the pool of possible random masks in that shard
[/list]

notes.title: Version v.083d - Quickfix
notes.notes: Added the possibility to perform a ritual in the city.

notes.title: Huge Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
[i]Version v.083[/i]

In this update, you'll find many bugfixes, QoL improvements, and tweaks that the community has been asking for a long time.

[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list][*] Added a new menu with detailed information on damage, crit multipliers, normal and magic crit chances. It can be accessed by clicking RMB on the damage icon. The menu makes stats more transparent and shows many of the stats that players previously had to calculate
[*] After many requests from players, we added automatic conversion of candles to wax at the end of the shards (in the towns), with the current exchange rate. Now this wax counts towards more flame power in the next shard. The exact number converted is shown by a new pop-up menu when entering a town
[/list]

[h3]Major corrections:[/h3]
[list][*] Lots of plant-related bugs have been fixed, in particular the 'Warm Radiance' skill scaling should now work normally for all plants (previously it only gave a bonus once every 10 levels or so). Typos and outdated descriptions have been fixed as well
[*] Wolf, General and Beetle transformation skills in their respective shards (Lunar, Clockwork, Luminous) are available earlier. Because of that, some other skills are available slightly earlier as well. Relevant information has been added to the shard descriptions
[*] More things are saved between game sessions! This update now includes saving and loading for all plant effects and all potion effects, as well as the 'March' skill. Previously they were reset after exiting the game. Where necessary, the descriptions have been changed a bit
[*] As a consequence, saving has been implemented for some related stats, such as % of poison on enemies or number of guaranteed crit hits, hero speed, and some others
[/list]

[h3]Minor fixes:[/h3]
[list][*]  Fixed a bug where if player had a lot of skill icons it could cover the potions submenu
[*]  Fixed that some weapon types were not getting the bonus from 'Rage of Darkness'
[*]  Fixed incorrect bonus from 2nd syllable of Dragon on Heavy and Primal Heavy weapons
[*]  Fixed that the 'Learn skill' soul action for General's gear skills didn't spend oil (now you can't abuse 'Ecology', for example).
[*]  Fixed the 'Dark Balance' skill in the Spirit skill tree in a similar way
[*]  Revised how bonus from taking any two syllables of 'P' sign work. Now when you take the bonus, General skill is no longer available on the level 9 of the player. Instead, the skill is moved to the stat 9 of Strength skill tree
[*]  Also fixed the bug that this bonus worked only from 4 syllables taken (not 2, as in the description)
[*]  Fixed a bug where with 'Mask of The Third Eye' you could take the General skill early for 1 SP (instead of 10 SP, as with all early unlocks)
[*]  Fixed big Mana and Energy values not fitting into their respective vials
[*]  Fixed incorrect description for Flame Flow when Flash skill and Rain syllables are taken. Added math for the fire stream amount to the description
[*]  The 'Desecrate Shards' button now gives the correct amount of wax (previously it did not take into account bonuses from the shards shop).
[*]  Fixed a rare bug where generation of new shard types could sometimes happen again if there were none left in current galaxy
[*]  Minor fixes for Madness visuals
[*]  Some fixes for weapon tooltip text
[*]  Extended changelog of previous update
[*]  And other rather minor fixes :)
[/list]

notes.title: Announcement: Epic Auto Towers, auto battler & deckbuilding mix.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce that I'm making a new game, "Epic Auto Towers"!

Epic Auto Towers is a turn-based strategy game combining elements of autobattler, deckbuilder and roguelike. Purchase uncommon and rare Towers and build the strongest combo to withstand the monster assault! Discover unusual new Tower combinations as you come back for more.

[b]For Grim Clicker, all updates are on track. Epic Auto Towers has been in development for quite some time and is being developed in parallel with Grim Clicker, so this game will not disturb Grim Clicker's way from Early Access.[/b]

notes.title: BUG WITH MISSING HITS FIXED!
notes.notes:
[i]Version v.075[/i]

[b]BUG WITH MISSING HITS FIXED![/b]

For a long time in the game there was a very unpleasant bug:
If you significantly speed up your hero, the hero would sometimes begin, on the contrary, to strike less often, or not to strike at all, despite the fast attack animation. 
This bug did not affect the beginning of the game too much, but it was extremely unpleasant because it affected highly leveled heroes. 

[u]Old versions[/u]
[b]Slow hits:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/7d8d8d435b4db032e674611865ea8e070ebcadf9.gif[/img]
[b]Fast hits:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/05b8a64e4be88bd0fc3abca017836ebfebdc2eda.gif[/img]
[b]Very fast hits:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/9f7f5ceb3cea0234bbbd4d8c3cf8681020b2859f.gif[/img]
[i]The red squares are information for debugging. A flying red square means that a hit has been made. So, in the last case, there are no hits made at all. That is, the speed of the animation does not correspond to the number of strikes delivered.[/i]

Because of this, for example, despite the fact that the game is almost ready by all parameters, taking it out of early access with this bug would not be very good. 
Now the way to complete the game is visible, which certainly makes us happy.

[u]New versions[/u]
[b]Fast hits:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/93430c95fb68ebdec69b9985096af61552270215.gif[/img]
[b]Very fast hits:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/f5c9f8c69c1722cc34791ca54c220f9ed5eca41c.gif[/img]

In general, the bug with skipping hits is finally fixed.
With the new system, high hero speed will definitely not lead to a decrease in
the number of hits. The hit rate will be slightly harder to increase 
after 7 hits per second (soft cap), and the hard cap will be 30 hits per second.

New potions do not drop in chests yet. We will change this later, and these potions will be able to drop from the chest. But we decided to update the game now because we did quite a lot and the flowers look fun.

We thank our players for their support! We've prepared a small gift for all Early Access players. (A gift will appear if you have performed more than four rituals.)

notes.title: Version 063 - Armageddon, Summon Phantom, Apocalypse Mask
notes.notes:
The game has been updated!

[h3]New skills[/h3][list]
[*] Summon Phantom (wisdom)
[*] Synergy (wisdom)
[*] Mask of the Apocalypse (strength)
[*] Armageddon (strength)
[*] Aura of fire (strength)
[/list]

Armageddon is notable for the fact that it works during the ritual, but deals permanent damage to monsters in the area.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/401fd1d95c1ab3a1dafd8dad339823d39abab92b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/ba8b458dd2d1d22bd223ae3ba2dd806b09c5529b.png[/img][/url]

[h3]New mechanics[/h3][list]
[*] Ice attack
[*] Mana Reservation
[/list]

Now the mana reservation is being used by the phantoms. But later we can add new skills that will also use this mechanics.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/40707b07064a86c5f97aef7a77758e5ec27d797a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/3a4805c0adf2191694e31f4067a78d5b73239dbd.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list]
[*] Clarified/corrected descriptions of some skills
[*] Fixed redistribution of points in wolf form
[*] Fixed display of souls speed in wolf form
[*] Bugfix: enemies getting stuck if jumping behind the hero, after loading the game
[*] Fixed exploit that allows to infinitely gain dexterity in shards where it is not reset
[*] Fixed bug with mechanic stone
[*] Fixed a glitch with the skill icon when applying poison
[*] Fixed a bug with turning into a wolf with a hotkey
[*] Fixed Monumentality: the weapon level will be set to 100 if the weapon level was higher when the skill was taken (extra levels don't count)
[*] Fixed buzzing weapon behavior at high attack speed
[/list]

notes.title: Version 062 - Forge of Souls, Space Tunnel, Transfer Area
notes.notes:
Forge of Souls added! The forge of souls appears in space when you reach a certain point on the space map. In the forge, you can upgrade souls actions, as well as open additional sets of actions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/5beab46e87ad0e3cfb2469523603adcb096e036d.png[/img]

A space tunnel has been added to space, starting with the transfer area. Through this tunnel, you can return to previous galaxies (in case the shards in the transfer area have been found too difficult).
In the transfer area itself monsters and bosses will be stronger, and the shards will have 60 and 70 zones!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/68e2f6c07d4524ec4118d451c25774cb7ce0c9be.png[/img]

We hope these changes will add a more challenge for players who have moved far in the game. The next few updates will focus on the start of the game or the game as a whole.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/b96cb248e42c5fa5dd336009288d34ff2c96e374.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/6277a49ffe9cf4e73a3c49b9c9cce9a878d50f72.png[/img][/url]

[u]Changelist:[/u][list]
[*] Added Forge of Souls (space)
[*] Added a tunnel (space)
[*] Monsters are enhanced in the transfer area, and to get to the town you need to pass more zones
[*] Added new sounds of space
[*] Added new music theme (forge of souls)
[*] Now, in the options menu, you can configure the autoclick cursor and enable/disable blood
[*] New galaxy names added
[/list]

notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added new singularity sign 'Rain'

[*] Wolf change: if you are in the form of a wolf, then the mask of the wolf and lycanthropy are available regardless of dexterity
[*] Fixed another bug in sprint skill

In fact, it turns out that dexterity has no nonworking skills left. Of course, some of these skills can still be changed in the future. Also, when we finish all the skills of the character, I guess we'll have to take one more look at the skills.

notes.title: Version 060 - THE WOLF!
notes.notes:
[h1]THE WOLF[/h1]
[b]With the skill of lycanthropy you can turn into a wolf. [/b]
If you perform the ritual in the form of a wolf, after the ritual the character will remain a wolf. The skill of lycanthropy is not necessary to maintain the form, it is necessary only for switching between the two appearances.

For the wolf, a wisdom is replaced by a lunar bond.
The whole branch of wisdom has other skills and a different look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/08f653d6649a803557cac58353689cd11e5bbaf3.jpg[/img]

[*] Added three new skills: Fireball (strength), Lycanthropy (dexterity), Thunderstorm (wisdom)
[*] Added Lunar bond and Lunar bond skilltree (+7 more skills)
[*] Added a new flying monster - harpy!
[*] The behavior and reward of the monster 'Eye' has been changed.
[*] Refined the appearance of the ghosts in the old castle
[*] Added 4 new achievements
[*] Added names of galaxies

[/list]

notes.title: Version 057 - Cosmetic update (new areas, new boss art, effects)
notes.notes:
[b]List of changes:[/b][list][*]Added new sounds for bats, bonfires, fireflies, fiery sword attacks, electricity and glove punches. The sound system as a whole is slightly rebuilt to prevent a large number of monotonous sound events.
[*]Added three new areas (volcano, red mountains, dark city).
[*]Added new flying monster: an eye (for the volcano area).
[*]Fixed a bug with the direction of fire spells. Now the flame is directed towards the enemy, if the enemy is standing behind the hero.
[*]The effects of an electric sword and a battle glove have been improved.

Effects setting is a slider with three gradations. When you select the lowest gradation, the number of effects is greatly reduced and the flying letters (exp gained, rubies gained, etc) are replaced by another messages mechanism.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35860351/cc6e423f98c6fed20fcf5153fbd90a592a5ec70e.png[/img]
 
In the next update we plan to add new hero skills, improve singularity skills, and perhaps add new items. (Option to reset the singularity points will be added as well.)

notes.title: Version 056 - Wisdom Branch
notes.notes:
The wisdom branch has been redone in this update. An item was also added that allows you to get stones from weapons. In addition, we managed to speed up the launch of the game (we upload the version with accelerated launch earlier than this announcement, so right now, probably, this change will be unnoticed).

[list]
[*] The game should start up faster (compared to previous versions)
[*] Added an item that allows you to extract stones from weapon
[*] Changes in the Wisdom branch:[list][*] Wisdom gives +0.1 to mana regeneration (was +0.05)
[*] Mana Lump damage is now scaled by weapon damage and max mana (Spell damage = [Skill level]*[Total weapon damage]*[Max mana])
[*] Mana Breath gives +10 to max mana and +50% to mana regen
[*] A spider regenerates 0.2 mana/s, but spiders benefit from bonuses
[*] The Flash skill has been redesigned
[*] Added new skill: Diviner's Luck (allows Mana Lump to kill several monster in a row, adds a magic crit mechanics)
[*] Added new mask: Mask Of The Third Eye (allows you to see all the skills, you can open an inaccessible skill for 10 SP, gives 10 SP)
[/list]
[*] Now you can see mana/energy regeneration values (by hovering cursor over mana/energy bulb)
[*] Added hotkeys for 'safe' usurpation (0, Num0)
[*] Fixed usurpation glitch when the wrong monsters were created
[*] Fixed several typos in the texts
[*] Added a few new names for galaxies
[*] Now you can open the singularity window without going into space
[*] Souls work mode is now saved
[*] Added crit counter for ambush skill (as well as effect and sound)
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update (Version 052)
notes.notes:
Version v.052

- Now you can view update information
- Added a message if the game was saved successfully
- Added warning on unsuccessful save (and instructions for solving the problem)
- Fixed bug with rubies in a rich chest
- Fixed a bug with the loss of the boss's chest (especially when exiting the menu)
- Added button to enable/disable weapon auto-upgrades
- Fixed a bug with bonfires in tutorial
- Fixed several bugs with sounds
- Fixed a bug with the knowledge window in the second galaxy
- Bloodshard now has special properties
- New music theme added

About the problem with saving backups for some players. As we have found out, saving a game can cause an error if non-Latin characters are used in the save path. We will try to deal with that problem, but for now a workaround is to save it to a folder with English name and to make sure that the save path contains only Latin characters.
